content: Sit upon a cold stone for three years, and it will become warm.
author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Ishi no ue ni mo san nen (石の上にも三年)
explanation: A cold granite slab feels uninhabitable at first touch. But through sustained, patient presence, body heat slowly permeates the stone until it is warm to the touch. No circumstance remains cold forever when met with unyielding devotion and quiet perseverance.
practicalInsight: When feeling restless or dissatisfied with a challenging project or role, remind yourself that deep roots take time to warm the cold soil.
reflectionPrompt: What worthwhile pursuit are you tempted to abandon prematurely simply because the initial season feels cold and unresponsive?
